IBPS Clerk CSA 15th Reserve List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the reserve list for the post of Clerk CSA (Customer Service Associates) 15th XV. The mains exam was conducted on 02 December 2025. This recruitment was released for 13533 posts. Applications for the IBPS Clerk CSA 15th (XV) Recruitment 2025 were accepted from August 01, 2025, to August 28, 2025. Candidates who have Qualified for the Mains exam can download their IBPS Clerk CSA 15th Reserve List 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 August 2025
  • Last Date for Registration : 28 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 August 2025
  • Correction Date : 02-03 September 2025
  • PET Exam Date : 29 September 2025
  • PET Admit Card : 24 September 2025
  • Pre Exam Date : 04, 05 – 11 October 2025
  • Pre Exam Admit Card : 24 September 2025
  • Pre Result : 20 November 2025 Available Now
  • Mains Exam Date : 02 December 2025
  • Mains Admit Card : 24 November 2025
  • Mains result : 02 March 2026
  • Allotment Reserve List : 15 June 2026
  • Reserve List : 15 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
